title: Information Technology | National Institute of Fashion Technology
text: Department of Information Technology (DoIT) “The Department of Information Technology is the digital backbone of NIFT—connecting people, processes, campuses and technology to create an intelligent, secure and future-ready fashion education ecosystem.” The Department of Information Technology (IT) of the National Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFT) serves as the digital backbone of the Institute, enabling technology-driven transformation across academic, administrative and institutional functions. The Department plays a strategic role in automating business processes, developing and maintaining enterprise applications, supporting academic and administrative operations, and introducing emerging technologies for fashion education and capacity building. The IT ecosystem of NIFT is designed to connect people, processes, technology and knowledge across its campuses, enabling efficient service delivery, data-driven decision-making, and a digitally empowered learning environment. Key Roles and Functions 1. Office Automation – Digital Document Filing System and HR Apps The Digital Document Filing System contributes significantly to the creation of a paperless and digitally enabled NIFT, while also providing a structured repository of institutional knowledge and records. The objective is to move HR operations from fragmented and paper-intensive processes towards an integrated, transparent and data-driven Human Resource Management environment. 2. Campus Management Solution – Student Lifecycle Management The Campus Management Solution (CMS) homegrown software that caters to the entire academic lifecycle, which includes Student Lifecycle Management, Placement, Alumni, Semester Exchange and Financial Assistance. CMS is a major component of NIFT's digital ecosystem. It supports the management of the student lifecycle, beginning with admission and continuing through the student's academic journey until graduation and beyond. 3. Enterprise Integration and Data Analytics The ERP unit also plays an important role in integrating information generated through different applications and converting institutional data into meaningful information. AI driven Business Intelligence tools used create useful dashboards for a. Institutional dashboards, b. Academic analytics, c. Student performance analysis, d. Faculty workload analysis, e. HR analytics, f. Campus-level performance monitoring. 4. Emerging Technologies for Fashion Learning A particularly important role of the Department is to assist the academic to identify, evaluate and procure emerging technologies that can transform fashion education. The convergence of fashion, technology and digital transformation is creating new possibilities for design, product development, manufacturing, retail and fashion business. NIFT's IT ecosystem can therefore serve as an enabler for the adoption of these technologies within teaching, learning and research. 5. Capacity Building A major responsibility of the Department is to build the digital capabilities of students, faculty and administrative staff. Technology adoption is successful only when users have the knowledge and confidence to use the technology effectively. The IT Department therefore supports continuous capacity building through: a. Faculty Development, b. Student Capacity Building, c. Administrative Capacity Building. 6. Uniform IT Infrastructure and Cybersecurity Across Campuses The Department of Information Technology is responsible for establishing a common, standardised, secure and integrated IT infrastructure across all NIFT campuses. text: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad Recruitment Examinations – 2026 LATEST NEWS Introduction By the Indian High Courts Act passed by British Parliament in 1861, provision was made, not only for the replacement of the Supreme Courts of Calcutta, Madras and Bombay and for the establishment of High Courts in their places, but for the establishment of a High Court by Letters Patent in any other part of Her Majesty's territories not already included in the jurisdiction of another High Court. In the year 1866, the High Court of Judicature for the North-Western Provinces came into existence at Agra under Letters Patent of the 17th March, 1866, replacing the old Sudder Diwanny Adawlat. Sir Walter Morgan, Barrister-at-Law and Mr. Simpson were appointed the first Chief Justice and the first Registrar respectively of High Court of North-Western Provinces. The seat of the High Court for the North-Western Provinces was shifted from Agra to Allahabad in 1869 and its designation was altered to 'the High Court of Judicature at Allahabad' by a supplementary Letters patent issued on March 11, 1919. title: Surrender of Indian Passport and Renunciation of Indian citizenship' | Embassy of India, Stockholm, Sweden
text: INDIAN PASSPORT SURRENDER CERTIFICATE APPLICATION Under the Indian Citizenship Act, 1955, Indian citizens are NOT allowed to hold DUAL Citizenship. If a person had ever held Indian nationality (and Passport) and subsequently voluntarily obtained nationality/Passport of another country, he/she ceases to be an Indian national (as per Section 9 of Citizenship Act) and is required only to surrender his/her Indian Passport. Step 1 Apply online at : Passport Seva Portal Upload photo and signature as per the official guidelines : ICAO Photo Guidelines and Signature Guidelines Step 2 Make online payment for the applicable service: Fees for Passport Services Step 3 Book an appointment through Embassy’s website for physical submission of documents at the Embassy: Book Appointment Check list for documents required for surrender certificate: - Duly filled and printed online application form with one blue ink signature on the last page in signature box. In case of minor, applicant’s thumb print impression required on first page and either parent is to sign on last page. - Self attested copy of Swedish Passport. - Self attested copy of Certificate of Registration/Naturalization of foreign nationality (Medborgarskap bevis) - Self attested copy of latest Indian Passport (first and last information page) - Latest Original Indian Passport to be surrendered. - Photograph and signature / thumb print to be uploaded and submitted online as per the ICAO standards strictly effective from 01 September 2025. Upload photo and signature as per the official guidelines : ICAO Photo Guidelines and Signature Guidelines - Latest Person Bevis or Extract of Population register issued by Skatteverket under applicant’s name for the residents of Sweden in English. - Payment fee receipt of SEK 396 along with applicant’s first name and application number on the message box. title: About | About Us | National Knowledge Network - Overview
text: About Overview National Knowledge Network (NKN) provides secure and reliable connectivity to education facilities, R&D Institutions, Indian mission critical agencies and government deployments. NKN is India’s REN (Research & Education Network), where NKN provides multi-gigabit connectivity connecting central & state universities, research Institutions of DAE, DRDO, ICAR, ICMR, etc., libraries, laboratories, healthcare institutions, judicial institutions, agricultural institutions, etc. across the nation bring about a paradigm shift in knowledge ecosystem of India. Vision NKN is a state-of-the-art Pan-India network and is a revolutionary step towards creating a knowledge society without boundaries. It will provide unprecedented benefits to the knowledge community and mankind at large. Using NKN, all vibrant institutions with vision and passion will be able to transcend space and time limitations in accessing information and knowledge and derive the associated benefits for themselves and for the society. It will facilitate the development of India's information infrastructure, stimulate research, and create next generation applications and services. Mission NKN is designed to provide high availability, Quality of Service, security and reliability. The purpose of NKN goes to the very core of the country’s quest for building quality institutions with requisite research facilities and to create a pool of highly trained professionals. The participating institutions at the edge would seamlessly connect to NKN at gigabit speed. NKN shall be a critical information infrastructure for India to evolve as a knowledge society. NKN is a significant step which will enable scientists, researchers and students from across the country to work together for advancing human development in critical and emerging areas. Goal In March 2010, the Cabinet Committee on Infrastructure (CCI) approved the establishment of the National Knowledge Network (NKN) to be implemented by NIC

title: About | About Us | National Knowledge Network (Part 2)
text: from across the country to work together for advancing human development in critical and emerging areas. Goal In March 2010, the Cabinet Committee on Infrastructure (CCI) approved the establishment of the National Knowledge Network (NKN) to be implemented by NIC over a period of 10 years. Establishing NKN is a significant step towards ushering in a knowledge revolution in the country with connectivity to 1800+ institutions. NKN is intended to connect all the knowledge and research institutions in the country using high bandwidth / low latency network. NKN has been established keeping the following features in mind: - Establishing a high-speed backbone connectivity which will enable knowledge and information sharing - Enabling collaborative research, development and Innovation - Facilitating advanced distance education in specialized fields such as engineering, science, medicine etc. - Facilitating an ultra-high speed backbone for e-Governance - Facilitating integration of different sectoral networks in the field of research, education, health, commerce and governance. - Link to Global Networks to collaborate with the research communities across the globe.

title: Government of India Web Directory (IGOD) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: The Government of India Web Directory (now Integrated Government Online Directory - IGOD at igod.gov.in) serves as the apex one-stop directory for all Indian government websites across the Union Government, State Governments, Union Territories, Judiciary, Apex Constitutional Bodies, and Legislature. Managed centrally by the National Informatics Centre (NIC) under the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology (MeitY), it indexes over 10,000 public portals classified across 30 socio-economic sectors such as Agriculture, Education, Health, Commerce, Power, and Public Grievances. Citizens and organizations can search official portals, verify authentic .gov.in and .nic.in domains, and access RSS feeds.

title: Integrated Government Online Directory (IGOD) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Integrated Government Online Directory (IGOD) is the official single-window digital registry for authentic government web presence in India. Operating under MeitY and NIC, IGOD provides structured navigation to Union Ministries, Departments, Apex Bodies, State Portals, and Autonomous Institutions. The platform verifies adherence to Guidelines for Indian Government Websites (GIGW), ensuring citizen accessibility, bilingual availability, cybersecurity standards, and official metadata classification.

title: National e-Mail Service (NIC Email) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: The National e-Mail Service (email.gov.in) is the sovereign, encrypted government messaging infrastructure developed and managed by the National Informatics Centre (NIC) for all Union and State government officers. Secured through two-factor authentication via the Kavach authentication application, geolocation IP geofencing, and strict data residency within government data centres, it handles millions of official communications daily. Citizen correspondence with departmental officers reaches jurisdictional email.gov.in inboxes, ensuring secure audit trails.

title: Government of India Webmail (mail.gov.in) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Government of India Webmail (mail.gov.in) is the unified secure gateway providing web-based email access to civil servants and public officials across India. Integrated with government personnel directories and LDAP, it enforces TLS 1.3 encryption, anti-phishing protection, and automated virus scanning to prevent data leaks. Public queries and administrative submissions routed to designated departmental nodal officers are processed through official mail.gov.in endpoints.

title: PM GatiShakti National Master Plan - Overview & Citizen Services
text: PM GatiShakti National Master Plan is India's transformational digital platform for multi-modal infrastructure connectivity, uniting 16 Union Ministries including Railways, Roads & Highways, Shipping, Telecom, and Power. Developed using BISAG-N (Bhaskaracharya National Institute for Space Applications and Geo-informatics) GIS spatial data, it provides dynamic 200+ layer spatial mapping for synchronised project planning, reducing logistics costs, minimizing clearances, and accelerating national infrastructure delivery across economic zones.

title: Districts of India Portal - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Districts of India Portal (districts.gov.in, unified under india.gov.in/districts) is the central directory of all 750+ administrative districts across 28 States and 8 Union Territories of India. Each district portal provides citizen services including revenue records, land title copies, domicile certificates, caste verification, ration card status, disaster management helplines, collectorate notices, and electoral rolls managed under the District Magistrate or Collector.

title: Saansad Adarsh Gram Yojana (SAANJHI) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Saansad Adarsh Gram Yojana (SAANJHI) is a rural development programme operated by the Ministry of Rural Development. Under the scheme, Members of Parliament (MPs) adopt gram panchayats to develop them into model village ecosystems by converging existing government schemes. The saanjhi.gov.in portal provides village development plans, real-time infrastructure milestone tracking, demographic profiles, and public transparency dashboards.

title: National Knowledge Network (NKN) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: National Knowledge Network (NKN) is India's multi-gigabit nationwide communications backbone connecting academic, scientific, and research institutions. Managed by the National Informatics Centre (NIC), NKN interconnects IITs, IISc, CSIR laboratories, agricultural universities, and supercomputing grids with high-speed, secure optical networks, enabling collaborative research, telemedicine, virtual classrooms, and large-scale scientific data sharing.

title: Ministry of Finance (FinMin) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: The Ministry of Finance is the apex union ministry responsible for India's macroeconomic management, taxation, financial legislation, financial institutions, capital markets, and union budget preparation. It comprises six departments: Economic Affairs, Expenditure, Revenue, Financial Services, Public Enterprises, and Investment & Public Asset Management (DIPAM). The official portal provides budget documents, economic surveys, tax notifications, and banking directives.

title: Central Public Procurement Portal (CPPP) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: The Central Public Procurement Portal (eprocure.gov.in / CPPP) is India's mandatory single-window platform for public tendering across all Union Ministries, Departments, Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs), and autonomous bodies. It supports online vendor registration, tender download, digital signature (DSC) secured bid submission, online tender opening, technical evaluation, and financial award generation, ensuring complete transparency in public procurement.

title: e-Procurement System of India (eTenders) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: The eTenders portal (etenders.gov.in), developed on the NIC GePNIC (Government e-Procurement System of NIC) engine, manages high-value public procurement tenders for Central and State Government departments. It enforces strict CVC (Central Vigilance Commission) procurement guidelines, transparent comparative bidding, two-cover evaluation, and automated tender status notifications for registered contractors, suppliers, and MSME vendors.

title: Government of India Tenders Portal - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Government of India Tenders Portal (tenders.gov.in, transitioning to the CPPP e-Publishing System) provides centralized access to tender notices, tender documents, corrigenda, and contract award notifications issued by public bodies. Vendors can search active bids by organization, classification, tender value, sub-department, and geographical location.

title: Public Financial Management System (PFMS) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Public Financial Management System (PFMS), administered by the Controller General of Accounts (CGA), Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance, is the digital backbone for fund tracking and Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) payments in India. PFMS connects over 250 banks, State treasuries, and implementing agencies, allowing citizens to check DBT payment status, scholarship credits, PM-KISAN disbursements, and government subsidy remittances via their bank account or Aadhaar number.

title: PRAAPTI Portal - Power Procurement Transparency - Overview & Citizen Services
text: PRAAPTI (Payment Ratification And Analysis in Power procurement for bringing Transparency in Invoicing of generators) is an official initiative by the Ministry of Power, Government of India. The platform captures invoicing data between power distribution companies (DISCOMs) and power generation companies (GENCOs), displaying nationwide overdue payments, dispute resolutions, and sector liquidity metrics to ensure financial discipline in India's power sector.

title: National Informatics Centre Examination Results Portal - Overview & Citizen Services
text: National Informatics Centre Examination Results Portal (results.gov.in) is the unified government server providing speedy online publication of board and entrance examination scores. It delivers results for CBSE 10th & 12th board exams, national eligibility tests, university semester examinations, state board examinations, and staff recruitment screenings, complete with roll-number verification and authenticated digital marksheet links.

title: Election Commission of India (ECI) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: The Election Commission of India (ECI) is the autonomous constitutional authority responsible for administering union and state election processes in India. The official portal publishes election schedules, candidate affidavits, Model Code of Conduct guidelines, delimitation orders, voter turnout metrics, live counting updates, and electoral reform research. Citizens can view political party registrations, complaint redressal via cVIGIL, and legal notifications.

title: ECI National Voters' Services Portal - Overview & Citizen Services
text: The National Voters' Services Portal (voters.eci.gov.in) is the unified digital citizen interface for all electoral services in India. Citizens can register as new voters (Form 6), apply as overseas electors (Form 6A), link Aadhaar with voter record (Form 6B), request corrections in name/photo/address or replacement EPIC card (Form 8), track application status, and download digital e-EPIC cards with secure QR codes for identification at polling booths.

title: National Voter Service Portal (NVSP - Migrated) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: National Voter Service Portal (nvsp.in) has officially migrated to the modernized portal voters.eci.gov.in under the Election Commission of India. It handles nationwide voter list searches by name or EPIC number, polling station officer contact info, online electoral roll corrections, deletion objections (Form 7), and migrant voter registration across all Assembly and Parliamentary constituencies.

title: Department of Justice (Ministry of Law and Justice) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: The Department of Justice, Ministry of Law and Justice, oversees judicial administration, infrastructure funding, and legal aid. Key citizen initiatives include Tele-Law (connecting rural citizens to legal aid panel lawyers via Common Service Centres), Nyaya Bandhu (pro bono legal services app connecting eligible beneficiaries with advocates), Fast Track Special Courts (FTSCs), and the National e-Courts Mission Mode Project enabling online case tracking across 19,000+ district and subordinate courts.

title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), steered by the National Health Authority (NHA), develops the digital backbone for India's integrated healthcare infrastructure. Through abdm.gov.in, citizens create a 14-digit Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) number and ABHA card, link digital health records from hospitals and diagnostics labs, grant consent for medical history access, and discover verified doctors via the Healthcare Professionals Registry (HPR) and Health Facility Registry (HFR).

title: Agricultural Marketing Information Network (AGMARKNET) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Agricultural Marketing Information Network (AGMARKNET) is a joint mission by the Directorate of Marketing & Inspection (DMI) and NIC under the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare. The portal provides daily commodity prices, market arrivals, and trend analysis across more than 3,000 agricultural produce wholesale markets (APMC Mandis) throughout India, empowering farmers with real-time price discovery.

title: National Animal Disease Reporting System (NADRS) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: National Animal Disease Reporting System (NADRS), operated under the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD), Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying, is an MIS application for computerized disease reporting from block veterinary dispensaries to national headquarters. It accelerates epidemic containment, vaccination campaigns, and animal health surveillance nationwide.

title: TrackChild Portal (Ministry of Women and Child Development) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: TrackChild is a national digital tracking system developed by the Ministry of Women and Child Development (MWCD) with NIC and police authorities. It maintains an online database of missing and found children, integrates with Child Care Institutions (CCIs), tracks Juvenile Justice board cases, and supports the Khoya-Paya citizen reporting platform for prompt recovery and rehabilitation.

title: Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organization (PESO) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organization (PESO), under DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, regulates the safety of manufacture, import, export, transport, storage, and usage of explosive substances, compressed gases, and petroleum in India. The portal supports online licensing (e-PESO), approval of pressure vessels, safety audits, and dangerous goods compliance certificates.

title: India Perspectives Magazine (MEA) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: India Perspectives is the flagship public diplomacy magazine published by the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), Government of India. Circulated globally in multiple languages, it showcases India's civilizational heritage, technological innovations, international relations, arts, cultural diversity, and global economic cooperation initiatives.

title: MP e-District Citizen Services Portal - Overview & Citizen Services
text: MP e-District Portal, operated by the State Agency for Public Services (SAPS), Government of Madhya Pradesh, delivers citizen certificates under the MP Public Services Guarantee Act (Lok Seva Guarantee Adhiniyam). Citizens can apply online for Domicile (Mool Niwas Praman Patra), Caste (Jati Praman Patra), Income (Aay Praman Patra), and Land Valuation certificates with digitally signed verification and SMS status tracking.

title: Madhya Pradesh Land Records (MP Bhulekh) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Madhya Pradesh Bhulekh (landrecords.mp.gov.in / mpbhulekh.gov.in), under the Revenue Department of Madhya Pradesh, provides computerized land ownership documents. Farmers and landholders can search and download certified copies of Khasra (plot record), Khatauni (record of rights - ROR), B1 Naksha (cadastral map), diverted land orders, and encumbrance certificates for agricultural and commercial parcels.

title: Commercial Tax Department, Madhya Pradesh - Overview & Citizen Services
text: The Commercial Tax Department of Madhya Pradesh manages state revenue taxation including State Goods and Services Tax (SGST), Value Added Tax (VAT) on petroleum products, Professional Tax, and Entry Tax. The portal facilitates online tax return filing, electronic challan generation, tax dealer registration, assessments, and dispute appeals for commercial establishments.

title: Madhya Pradesh Education Portal (Shiksha Portal) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Madhya Pradesh Education Portal (Shiksha Portal), managed by the School Education Department of Madhya Pradesh, is a comprehensive education MIS. It tracks student enrollment, school profiles (DISE), scholarship disbursals across 30+ categories, free textbook distribution, teacher payroll, transfers, and board examination performance for state government schools.

title: MP Employees Selection Board (MP ESB / Vyapam) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MP ESB, formerly MP Professional Examination Board - PEB), conducts competitive examinations for recruitment to state government posts and professional course admissions (e.g. Police Constable, Patwari, Sub-Engineer, Teacher Eligibility Test - TET). The portal delivers exam notifications, admit cards, answer keys, objection tracking, and normalized merit lists.

title: Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC), established under Article 315 of the Constitution of India, conducts examinations and interviews for recruitment to Madhya Pradesh state civil services, police services (DSP), accounts services, and forest services. The official portal provides application forms, examination syllabi, previous papers, cut-off marks, and interview interview results.

title: MP e-Khanij Mineral Administration Portal - Overview & Citizen Services
text: MP e-Khanij Portal is the official digital mining administration platform of the Mineral Resources Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh. It governs mining lease grants, electronic transit passes (e-TP), royalty calculations, weighbridge automation, mineral transport vehicle tracking, and illegal mining surveillance to ensure lawful extraction of major and minor minerals.

title: Madhya Pradesh e-Procurement Portal (MP Tenders) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: MP Tenders (mptenders.gov.in), developed on the NIC GePNIC framework, handles e-tendering for all Madhya Pradesh government departments, municipal corporations, and public undertakings. It supports digital vendor registration, secure tender download, two-stage bidding, electronic payment of EMD, and transparent tender awards for civil, electrical, and commercial works.

title: Chief Electoral Officer (CEO), Madhya Pradesh - Overview & Citizen Services
text: The Chief Electoral Officer of Madhya Pradesh conducts Parliamentary and Assembly elections in Madhya Pradesh under the superintendence of the ECI. The portal provides draft and final electoral rolls, voter search by name or EPIC number, polling station maps, Model Code of Conduct monitoring, and district election officer directories.

title: Karnataka State Centre - National Informatics Centre - Overview & Citizen Services
text: NIC Karnataka State Centre (kar.nic.in) leads the architecture and deployment of mission-mode e-governance systems in Karnataka, including Bhoomi (land records), Kaveri (property registration), Khajane (treasury management), Seva Sindhu (citizen services), and Panchatantra (Gram Panchayat MIS), driving digital public services across the state.

title: Karnataka Appellate Tribunal (KAT) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Karnataka Appellate Tribunal (KAT) is the premier administrative tribunal hearing statutory appeals and revision petitions against decisions of revenue authorities, cooperative societies registrars, and commercial tax commissioners in Karnataka. The portal provides daily cause lists, case status, certified copy applications, and published tribunal orders.

title: Finance Department, Government of Karnataka - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Finance Department, Government of Karnataka, manages the state's economic policy, public expenditure, annual budget presentation, and fiscal management. Through the Khajane-II integrated financial management system, it automates treasury bill clearances, government employee salaries, pension disbursements, and public debt management.

title: Value Added Tax / Commercial Taxes Karnataka - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Commercial Taxes Department of Karnataka (formerly vat.kar.nic.in, now integrated with gstkarnataka.gov.in) administers state taxes, including Karnataka Goods and Services Tax (KGST), Profession Tax (KPT), and non-GST commodity taxes. The portal provides online registration, tax return submissions, electronic payment facilities, and tax clearance certifications.

title: Commercial Taxes Department, Government of Karnataka - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Commercial Taxes Department, Government of Karnataka (ctax.kar.nic.in), oversees the administration of revenue taxes across Karnataka. It delivers services including e-Way Bill monitoring, e-Sugam for non-GST goods, input tax credit reconciliations, dealer audits, and taxpayer facilitation desks for trade and industry.

title: Health & Family Welfare Services Karnataka - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Department of Health and Family Welfare Services, Government of Karnataka, delivers primary, secondary, and tertiary public healthcare services. It administers the Ayushman Bharat - Arogya Karnataka cashless health insurance scheme, maternal and child healthcare, immunization programs, blood bank directories, and state healthcare infrastructure.

title: Department of Labour, Government of Karnataka - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Department of Labour, Government of Karnataka, protects the rights and welfare of organized and unorganized workers. Through the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (KBOCWWB) and Karmika portal, workers can register for welfare benefits, educational scholarships, maternity assistance, pension schemes, and accident relief.

title: Department of Public Libraries, Government of Karnataka - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Department of Public Libraries, Karnataka, manages the network of state central, district central, and taluk libraries. The digital portal allows citizens to access thousands of e-books, research journals, competitive exam preparation resources, and rare historical manuscripts in Kannada, English, and regional languages through a unified digital library membership.

title: Home Department, Government of Karnataka - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Home Department, Government of Karnataka, supervises law enforcement, internal security, fire services, and prison administration. In coordination with Karnataka State Police (KSP), it delivers citizen services including online police verification for passports and employment, FIR search, lost report filing, tenant verification, and the 112 emergency response support system (ERSS).

title: Raita Mitra - Agriculture Department Karnataka - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Raita Mitra is the official agricultural extension portal of the Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka. It assists farmers with subsidized seeds and fertilizers distribution, soil health card testing, micro-irrigation subsidies (Drip/Sprinkler under PMKSY), custom hiring centres for farm equipment, and Krishi Sanjeevini mobile plant clinic diagnostic visits.

title: Krishi Marata Vahini - APMC Market Rates Karnataka - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Krishi Marata Vahini, operated by the Karnataka State Agricultural Marketing Board (KSAMB), publishes daily commodity arrivals, minimum, maximum, and modal market prices across all APMC (Agricultural Produce Market Committee) mandis in Karnataka. Farmers can track live price trends to plan the sale of cereals, pulses, oilseeds, fruits, and vegetables.

title: Asset Management System Karnataka - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Asset Management System (AMS), Government of Karnataka, is an enterprise GIS-based portal for recording, managing, and maintaining public assets, government lands, civil infrastructure, and state-owned buildings, ensuring optimal utilization and protection of public property.

title: Department of Cooperation, Karnataka - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Department of Cooperation, Government of Karnataka, governs primary agricultural credit societies (PACS), cooperative banks (DCCBs), housing societies, and urban credit cooperatives. The portal facilitates online society registration, statutory audit tracking, election management, and grievance redressal.

title: Karnataka State Pollution Control Board (KSPCB) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Karnataka State Pollution Control Board (KSPCB) implements environmental protection statutes across Karnataka. Through its online consent management system (OCMMS / Parisara), industrial units apply for Consent for Establishment (CFE) and Consent for Operation (CFO), submit environmental statements, and monitor air and water quality compliance.

title: Department of School Education Karnataka (SATS) - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Department of School Education and Literacy, Karnataka, administers school education policies, curriculum, and examinations (KSEAB). Through the Student Achievement Tracking System (SATS), every student in Karnataka is assigned a unique enrollment number tracking academic progress, attendance, mid-day meal benefits, and scholarship distributions.

title: Kaveri Online Property Registration Karnataka - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Department of Stamps and Registration, Government of Karnataka, operates the Kaveri Online Services portal (karnregs.kar.nic.in / kaverionline.karnataka.gov.in). Citizens can calculate stamp duty and registration fees, book sub-registrar appointment slots, apply for online Encumbrance Certificates (EC), and obtain certified copies of registered property sale deeds.

title: Planning, Programme Monitoring & Statistics Karnataka - Overview & Citizen Services
text: Planning, Programme Monitoring and Statistics Department, Government of Karnataka, spearheads state development planning, Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) tracking, socio-economic surveys, district planning allocations, and evaluation of flagship public welfare programmes.

title: Wildlife Wing - Forests & Wildlife Department Haryana - Overview & Citizen Services
text: The Wildlife Wing of the Department of Forests and Wildlife, Government of Haryana, protects wildlife sanctuaries (including Sultanpur National Park and Kalesar National Park), manages animal rescue operations, prevents poaching under the Wildlife Protection Act, and promotes eco-tourism initiatives.
